changeSet.author: bilous
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO task (lesson_id, title, task_type, min_score, max_score) SELECT l.id, 'mock_task_' + CAST(l.id AS VARCHAR(10)), 'quiz', 0, 100 FROM lesson l WHERE l.title LIKE 'Mock Lesson %' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.lesson_id = l.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM task WHERE title LIKE 'mock\_task\_%';
